en-US.author: Google LLC
en-US.longDescription:
Ask anything with the Google app for desktop. Using a simple keyboard shortcut, get quicker access to AI-powered responses and keep exploring with follow-up questions and helpful links.
With Lens and screen sharing built into the app, you can also ask about any part of your screen, whether a specific window or your entire screen. Plus, easily find apps and files across your computer and Google Drive—all from the Search box.
en-US.name: Google

zh-CN.longDescription:
通过桌面版 Google 应用随时提问。使用简单的键盘快捷键，更快获取 AI 生成的回答，并通过后续问题和实用链接继续探索。
应用内置 Lens 和屏幕共享功能，你可以就屏幕的任何部分提问，无论是特定窗口还是整个屏幕。此外，还可以在搜索框中轻松查找电脑和 Google 云端硬盘中的应用和文件。
